title: Balanced Brackets
statement: Read a string containing only the characters ( ) [ ] { }. Print 'YES' if every opening bracket has a matching closing bracket of the same type, correctly nested and in the right order, otherwise print 'NO'.
starter_code:
s = input().strip()
# TODO: use a stack to check whether the brackets in s are balanced; print YES or NO
hints: Push opening brackets onto a stack
On a closing bracket, check the top of the stack is the matching opener before popping
At the end, the stack must be empty for the string to be balanced
